## Operating Hours (Asia/Jerusalem Timezone)
- **Sunday – Saturday (every day)**: 09:00 – 24:00
- All flight sessions require advance booking; online booking is open 24/7.
- Where a package lists a prime-time price it applies to evening departures (from 18:00) and to Saturdays; day-of-week limits of a promotion are stated in its package line.

## Public Transit & Parking Directions
- **Yehudit Light Rail Station (Red Line)**: 350 meters / 4-minute walk. Exit Yehudit underground station (Red Line) toward Yitzhak Sadeh / HaMasger → Walk south-east along Montefiore streets into Gershon Shatz St 36 (~350m, 4 min walk).
- **Tel Aviv HaShalom Train Station (Israel Railways)**: 750 meters / 9-minute walk. Exit HaShalom Train Station (Azrieli) west toward Begin Rd → Walk 8–10 minutes south via Derech Menachem Begin & Yitzhak Sadeh St (or hop 1 stop on Red Line Light Rail to Yehudit Station) → Arrive at Gershon Shatz St 36.
- **Parking**: Paid municipal street parking (Blue & White curb markings) on Gershon Shatz St and the surrounding Montefiore streets, or nearby private paid parking lots.

## Participant Rules & Facility Regulations (תקנון)
- **Minimum Pilot Age**: 10+ years old. Participants aged 10–15 must be accompanied by an adult (18+).
- **Booking Customer Age**: Online reservations and card payments must be made by an adult aged 18+.
- **Cockpit Observers (Jumpseat Guests)**: Up to 2 companions may watch inside the cockpit free of charge; an extra seat is a paid add-on.
- **Arrival Time**: Arrive 5 minutes before the scheduled session.
- **Late Arrival Policy**: Session time includes the pre-flight briefing inside the cockpit. Delays over 10 minutes may shorten the session (no refund for lost time) or require rescheduling subject to a change fee.
- **Nature of Facility**: A 1:1 scale experiential Boeing 737 flight deck with motorized control loading, flown with an instructor. It is an entertainment and training-preparation facility, not a licensed pilot-certification institution.

## Flight Packages & Pricing (ILS, server-authoritative)
Prices and durations below are the live registry values the booking engine charges (`/book`). Daytime prices apply unless a prime-time price is listed.

### Experience Flights (consumer, no flight experience required)
- **Discovery Flight — 30-Minute Boeing 737 Experience** (30 min): ₪450. A guided 30-minute Boeing 737 mission with takeoff, hands-on flight and landing. Customize your mission with Cold & Dark (+20m), Classical EU Airports (+40m), Crosswind/IFR (+15m), or Extreme Approaches (+25m) in Step 2.
- **Daytime Special Flight (45m Promo)** (45 min): ₪490. Discounted promotion tariff, Sunday–Tuesday before 18:00. A 45-minute flight session with two landings and weather scenarios.
- **Captain's Command Flight (60m)** (60 min): ₪690. Includes Takeoff & Landing Exercise + 1 Full World Trio Theme (3 iconic airport landings of your choice), live weather challenges & up to 2 free cockpit guests.
- **Captains' Challenge & Multi-Trio Odyssey (90m)** (90 min): ₪850 daytime / ₪950 prime-time. Includes Takeoff & Landing Exercise + 2 World Trio Themes (up to 6 airports), Cold & Dark or V1 Engine-Out emergencies, and 1 or 2 pilots sharing the controls.

### Fear of Flying
- **Fear of Flying Overcoming Course** (60 min): ₪690. A gentle, empowering 60-minute session with an experienced captain to demystify sounds, turbulence, and flight safety.

### Professional Training (airline interview and assessment preparation)
- **Airline Interview Prep 60 PRO** (60 min): ₪950. Focused 60-minute PRO visual & IFR instrument flight training and airline simulator screening preparation.
- **Airline Interview Prep 90 PRO** (90 min): ₪1,285. Extended 90-minute PRO airline assessment checkride prep covering Raw Data, SID/STAR programming, and V1 Engine-Out profiles.
- **Airline Interview Prep 120 PRO** (120 min): ₪1,590. Comprehensive 120-minute (2-Hour) masterclass for commercial pilots, cadets, and two-crew MCC/airline assessment candidates.

### Corporate Workshops
- **Corporate CRM Leadership Workshop** (240 min): ₪4,500. High-stakes leadership and team decision-making workshop adapted from commercial aviation Crew Resource Management. Up to 10 participants.

### Flight Mission Upgrades & Add-Ons (consumer flights only)
Add-ons extend a consumer Experience Flight. Professional and Fear of Flying sessions carry no add-ons.
- **Boeing 737 Cold & Dark Cockpit Startup** (+20 min): ₪200
- **X-Wind / Live METAR / IFR Instrument Conditions** (+15 min): ₪250
- **Extreme World Airports Trio — Paro (VQPR), Hong Kong Kai Tak (VHHX) & Innsbruck (LOWI)** (+25 min): ₪450
- **Classical EU Hubs Trio — London Heathrow (EGLL), Paris CDG (LFPG) & Amsterdam (EHAM)** (+40 min): ₪450
- **Mediterranean Islands & Riviera Trio — Corfu (LGKR), Skiathos (LGSK) & Nice (LFMN)** (+40 min): ₪450
- **American Megacities Skyline Trio — New York (KLGA), Washington (KDCA) & San Francisco (KSFO)** (+40 min): ₪450
- **City-Center & Night Neon Trio — London City (EGLC), Tokyo Haneda (RJTT) & Las Vegas (KLAS)** (+40 min): ₪450
- **Alpine & Fjord Mountain Masters Trio — Queenstown (NZQN), Geneva (LSGG) & Salzburg (LOWS)** (+40 min): ₪450
- **Tropical Caribbean & Ocean Runways Trio — St. Maarten (TNCM), Rio (SBRJ) & Maldives (VRMM)** (+40 min): ₪450
- **Aviation Legends & Iconic Hubs Trio — Dubai (OMDB), Gibraltar Rock (LXGB) & Larnaca (LCLK)** (+40 min): ₪450
- **Extra Cockpit Jumpseat Passenger**: ₪90
